worldcombat.skill.counter.summary: Returns the most recent physical damage it took at double strength; with no debt recorded, the blow whiffs.
worldcombat.skill.counter.use.0: Answer a heavy physical hit at once
worldcombat.skill.counter.use.1: Punish a high-attack foe that fights point blank
worldcombat.skill.counter.use.2: Turn damage taken into damage dealt
worldcombat.skill.counter.description.0: Returns twice the latest physical hit, about %1$s damage. Only the latest hit within %2$s is remembered, and using the move clears it. Records expire for Pokémon and ordinary creatures alike.
worldcombat.skill.counter.description.1: Steps in up to %1$s blocks, %2$s blocks per tick, collision radius %3$s blocks; on a hit it knocks the target back %4$s blocks, stopping at the first enemy or terrain in the way. The blow settles as fixed damage that type immunity blocks outright; the refund never exceeds %5$s of the user's maximum health.
worldcombat.skill.counter.deepbreath.on: Patient stance on: the ledger window is 1 s longer, prepare takes 3 ticks more and cooldown 6 ticks more; it waits for a heavier hit but acts slower.
worldcombat.skill.counter.deepbreath.off: Patient stance off: quicker to answer and only the freshest debt counts.
worldcombat.skill.counter.timing: Castable on enemies within %1$s blocks; commits after %2$s s and costs %4$s PP; recovers for %3$s s and starts a %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.counter.growth.0: At level %1$s the refund cap rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.counter.growth.1: At level %1$s the refund cap rises to %2$s and the ledger window extends to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.counter.preference.dee: On: the ledger window is 1 s longer, but prepare takes 3 ticks and cooldown 6 ticks more, waiting for a heavier hit. Off: quicker to answer and only the freshest debt counts.
Only chase the debtor within this distance to collect the ledger; a larger value pursues the debt further.
